name: the sanity check is a boolean
description: data.sane answers whether the live index configuration still matches the one this service would create today. False is a normal answer, not an error — it is the designed signal that a mapping changed and a reindex is due, which is exactly what a deployment upgrading into the CJK subfield sees. Only the key and its type are pinned; the value depends on what the index looked like before this fixture ran.
